tools.name: robotics-intelligence_rosbag-telemetry-parse
tools.description: Parse caller-supplied ROS bag topic CSV/JSON exports into labeled telemetry samples when reviewing a robotics or automation plan. Binary .bag/.mcap files are not fully decoded and live robots are not contacted. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, samples and others. Returns checkedAt, t

tools.name: robotics-intelligence_ros-topic-schema-diff
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied left/right ROS topic message types and fields when reviewing a robotics or automation plan. Missing schemas are not invented. Call with optional text, json, csv, file, files, samples and others. Returns checkedAt, topicCount, items, paidProviderUsed, apiKeyRequired, liveEquip

tools.name: robotics-intelligence_telemetry-anomaly-detect
